findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name File System Access and JSON Loading
 * @description Detects file system access and JSON loading operations to identify potential input sources and sinks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/file-and-json-access
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 *        external/cwe/cwe-073
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("io").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getMember(["read_text", "read_bytes", "open"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("importlib.resources").getMember(["files", "read_text", "read_binary", "open_text", "open_binary"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("importlib_resources").getMember(["files", "read_text", "read_binary", "open_text", "open_binary"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File access or JSON load operation."
findings.hypothesis: The package might read files or resources based on external input (Path Traversal/Resource Injection) or process unsafe JSON.

message.text: File access or JSON load operation.
File access or JSON load operation.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect file loading arguments
 * @description Inspect arguments passed to importlib.resources.files and joinpath to check for user input
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-file-loading
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("importlib.resources").getMember("files").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("importlib_resources").getMember("files").getACall() or
  call.asExpr().(Attribute).getAttr() = "joinpath"
select call, "File resource access detected, check arguments."
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal via resource loading if arguments are user-controlled.

message.text: File resource access detected, check arguments.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect json.loads arguments
 * @description Dump arguments of json.loads to understand their origin
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-json-loads
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("loads").getACall()
select call, "json.loads called with argument: " + call.getArg(0).asExpr().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Investigate source of data passed to json.loads
